questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code validates the relationship between the configured bitrate settings? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A deployment sets stream.startBitrateKbps to an empty value (the line is present but blank) and stream.maxBitrateKbps=6000. Which start bitrate does the loaded config contain?
choices: It fails with a ConfigException because an empty value is not an integer
0, since an empty string parses as zero
The start bitrate is derived as half of the max, 3000
1500, because a blank value is treated the same as an absent one

questions.prompt: stream.allowedRegions is set to " , " (spaces and a comma only). What happens?
choices: load throws a ConfigException because no region remains after trimming and filtering empties
The config is created with a list containing two empty strings
The default regions us,eu are used because the value is effectively blank
The config is created with an empty region list, so every admit() call returns false

questions.prompt: With default settings, what initial bitrate does PlaybackPlanner.initialBitrateKbps return for a measured bandwidth of 400 kbps?
choices: 320, which is 80 percent of the measurement
